title: Rhyming words
examples: Can you show me words that sound like 'mouse'?
How do I know if two words rhyme?

explain.say: Listen to this word. It is cat. Can you say cat for me?
Now listen to this word. It is hat. Does hat sound like cat?
This word is bat. Does bat sound the same as cat and hat?
Rhyming words sound the same at the end. Cat and hat sound the same at the end.
Look at the picture. A cat and a hat go together. They rhyme!
Sometimes words do not rhyme. Look at 'dog' and 'tree'. They sound very different.

draw.text: dog and tree do not rhyme

faq.a: It means that words sound the same at the end. For example, 'fun' and 'sun' rhyme.
asks: What does it mean to rhyme?

faq.q: How do I know if two words rhyme?
faq.a: You listen very carefully to the sounds at the end of both words. If the sounds match, they rhyme.
asks: Can you help me check if words rhyme?
Are the last sounds the same?

faq.a: No, only some words rhyme. You have to listen to see if the sounds match.
asks: Are there words that never rhyme?
Must words rhyme to be friends?
Is it hard to know if words rhyme?

faq.q: Can you give me more rhyming words?
faq.a: Yes, I can give you lots more rhyming words. We can find words that end with the same sound.
asks: Can we play a rhyming game?

faq.a: No, the first sound does not matter for rhyming. Only the sounds at the end need to match.
asks: Does the start of the word matter?
Do the first letters have to match?

facts: Rhyming words have matching sounds at the end.
You can use your ears to listen for rhymes.
Words like 'cat' and 'hat' are rhyming words.
The sounds must match, not just the letters.

quiz.why: Sat rhymes with mat because they both end with the /at/ sound.

wrong.0: Man does not rhyme because the ending sound is different.
wrong.1: Map does not rhyme because the vowel sound is different.
wrong.2: This is the same word, but we need a different rhyming word.

quiz.why: Cat and hat rhyme because they both share the same ending sound /at/.

wrong.0: Hat and dog do not rhyme because the sounds do not match at the end.
wrong.2: This is also a rhyming pair, but we are looking for the best option given the choices.
wrong.3: Dog and cat do not rhyme because their ending sounds are different.
